findings.title: Startup index watch skips writes that happen during build
findings.body: searchSupport.init builds each namespace with ListIterator, then discards the resource version build returns and only afterwards calls WatchWriteEvents. That watch snapshots the latest RV and polls only events newer than that snapshot. Any write committed after a namespace was listed but at or before the watch snapshot is neither in the index nor replayed. build's own comment says watching must resume from the RV just read. Because Init now runs once at process start and is no longer retried on later RPCs, those documents stay missing from search until another write to the same key.

findings.title: Index init goroutines share err and can hide build failures
findings.body: The errgroup workers in searchSupport.init all assign the outer err from s.build and then return that same err, and they also increment totalBatchesIndexed with no synchronization. Another worker can overwrite err between the assignment and the return, so errgroup.Wait can observe nil even though a build failed (or a spurious error). Init is now synchronous in NewResourceServer and once.Do never retries, so a lost failure starts the server with a partial search index and no error to the caller.

findings.title: BuildIndex no longer serializes same-key builds
findings.body: cacheMu used to be held for the entire BuildIndex. It is now taken only to publish the finished index. getOrCreateIndex is check-then-build with no per-key lock, so two callers for the same NamespacedResource can both see a cache miss and both call bleve.New on the same deterministic directory (Root/namespace/resource.group) or both allocate a memory index. Concurrent bleve.New on one path fails or corrupts the on-disk index; the loser is leaked, and the cache keeps whichever build finishes last, which may not be the one already returned to an in-flight search.

findings.title: TotalDocs ranges the index cache without the mutex
findings.body: TotalDocs iterates b.cache with no cacheMu, while BuildIndex writes b.cache[key] under that lock. The new init log calls TotalDocs immediately after starting the search watch goroutine, which can getOrCreateIndex and BuildIndex for namespaces below InitMinCount as soon as the first poll arrives. Concurrent map read and write panics the process during startup.

findings.title: Postgres storage-server integration test is now skipped
findings.body: TestIntegrationWillRunInstrumentationServerWhenTargetHasNoHttpServer is the integration coverage for the storage-server target, and this PR skips it entirely when GRAFANA_TEST_DB=postgres, with a TODO that it fails in Drone. Eager Init inside NewResourceServer is exactly what that test exercises via InitializeModuleServer. Skipping it removes the signal for a postgres startup regression instead of fixing it, so this change can merge while unified storage fails to come up on postgres in CI.
